answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric anchoring prevents Sybil attacks by tying identities to biological uniqueness. An attacker cannot echo thousands of identities, as each requires a costly physical verification process. Much like the dense, structural integrity of cedar wood, this foundation resists fraudulent erosion. Just as a wharf supports ships, this mechanism supports a secure agent economy by imposing high financial and temporal costs, forcing malicious actors to exhaust resources without gaining systemic influence.
